ex.en: I rented a house with a garage.
ex.zh: 我租了一間附車庫的房子。

ex.en: He backed his car into the garage.
ex.zh: 他把車倒進車庫。

ex.en: The boys' bicycle is in the garage.
ex.zh: 男孩們的腳踏車在車庫裡。

garage.en: a building or space where you keep a car

ex.en: My car is at the garage for repairs.
ex.zh: 我的車在修車廠修理。

ex.en: The garage charged me too much for the new tires.
ex.zh: 修車廠的新輪胎收我太多錢了。

garage.en: a place where cars are repaired

ex.en: Don't forget to take out the garbage.
ex.zh: 別忘了把垃圾拿出去倒。

ex.en: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
ex.zh: 在我們的城市，大家都會仔細做垃圾分類和回收。

ex.en: Throwing garbage on the street is not a good habit, remember?
ex.zh: 在街上亂丟垃圾不是好習慣，記得嗎？

ex.en: These garments are made of 100 percent wool.
ex.zh: 這些衣服是百分之百羊毛製的。

ex.en: The factory produces garments for export.
ex.zh: 這家工廠生產外銷成衣。

ex.en: Hang the garment up to keep it from wrinkling.
ex.zh: 把衣服掛起來，免得起皺。

ex.en: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.
ex.zh: 油價很可能會上漲。

ex.en: The car ran out of gasoline on the highway.
ex.zh: 車子在高速公路上沒油了。

gasoline.en: a liquid fuel used in cars

ex.en: Five gallons of regular, please.
ex.zh: 請加五加侖的普通汽油。

ex.en: The tank holds 15 gallons of gas.
ex.zh: 油箱可以裝十五加侖的汽油。

gallon.en: a unit for measuring liquid, about four liters

ex.en: The gardener planted a rose tree in the middle of the garden.
ex.zh: 園丁在花園中央種了一棵玫瑰。

ex.en: We hired a gardener to take care of the lawn.
ex.zh: 我們請了一位園丁來照顧草坪。

gardener.en: a person who works with plants in a garden

ex.en: Do you like to gamble?
ex.zh: 你喜歡賭博嗎？

ex.en: You don't like gambling, do you?
ex.zh: 你不喜歡賭博，對吧？

gamble.en: to risk money on a game or race in order to win more

ex.en: Starting a business is always a gamble.
ex.zh: 創業總是一場冒險。

ex.en: The gamble paid off in the end.
ex.zh: 這場冒險最後成功了。

gamble.en: an action with a risk that may or may not work out

ex.en: The police arrested members of a local gang.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了當地幫派的成員。

ex.en: He joined a gang when he was young.
ex.zh: 他年輕時加入了幫派。

gang.en: a group of criminals or young people who cause trouble

ex.en: The whole gang is coming to my party.
ex.zh: 那群朋友全都會來我的派對。

ex.en: I went out with the gang from work.
ex.zh: 我跟公司那群同事出去玩。

gang.en: a group of friends who spend time together

gang.zh: gang up on：聯手對付、圍攻

ex.en: They always gang up on the new kid.
ex.zh: 他們總是聯手欺負新來的孩子。

ex.en: Don't gang up on me!
ex.zh: 別聯合起來對付我！

gang.en: to join together to attack or treat someone badly

ex.en: The fuel gauge is broken.
ex.zh: 油表壞了。

ex.en: When did the fuel gauge stop working?
ex.zh: 油表是什麼時候壞的？

gauge.en: a tool that measures the amount of something

ex.en: It's hard to gauge how customers will react.
ex.zh: 很難判斷顧客會有什麼反應。

ex.en: We sent out a survey to gauge interest.
ex.zh: 我們發出問卷來了解大家的興趣。

gauge.en: to form an opinion about how much or how likely something is

ex.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
ex.zh: 棒球比賽因雨取消了。

ex.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
ex.zh: 他喜歡看電視轉播的棒球比賽。

game.en: a sports event between teams or players

ex.en: Whatever game I play with you, you never win.
ex.zh: 不管跟你玩什麼遊戲，你都贏不了。

ex.en: I don't have time to play games with you.
ex.zh: 我沒時間陪你玩遊戲。

ex.en: I need to buy a gaming laptop.
ex.zh: 我需要買一台電競筆電。

game.en: an activity with rules that people play for fun

ex.en: The burglar gained access to the house through this door.
ex.zh: 竊賊是從這扇門進入屋內的。

ex.en: You gain nothing by speaking ill of others.
ex.zh: 說別人壞話，你什麼也得不到。

ex.en: She gained a lot of experience at her first job.
ex.zh: 她在第一份工作中累積了很多經驗。

gain.en: to get something useful or wanted

ex.en: I gained three kilos during the holidays.
ex.zh: 我放假期間胖了三公斤。

ex.en: The stock gained 5% today.
ex.zh: 這檔股票今天上漲了 5%。

gain.en: to become more in weight, speed or value

ex.en: The company reported a gain in profits.
ex.zh: 公司公布獲利增加。

ex.en: Weight gain is common in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天體重增加很常見。

gain.en: an increase in something, or a benefit

ex.en: There is a garden in front of the house.
ex.zh: 房子前面有一座花園。

ex.en: This is the most beautiful flower in the garden.
ex.zh: 這是花園裡最漂亮的一朵花。

ex.en: We grow vegetables in our garden.
ex.zh: 我們在院子裡種菜。

garden.en: a piece of land near a house where flowers or vegetables grow

ex.en: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
ex.zh: 我想請你幫我整理花園。

ex.en: My grandmother loves to garden on weekends.
ex.zh: 我奶奶週末很喜歡整理花園。

garden.en: to work in a place where plants grow

ex.en: Tom puts gas in his car twice a week.
ex.zh: 湯姆每週幫車子加兩次油。

ex.en: Ten minutes later, our car ran out of gas.
ex.zh: 十分鐘後，我們的車就沒油了。

ex.en: Gas prices went up again this week.
ex.zh: 這週油價又漲了。

gas.en: a liquid fuel for cars, in American English

ex.en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.
ex.zh: 眾所周知，空氣是多種氣體的混合物。

ex.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
ex.zh: 這場爆炸可能是瓦斯外洩造成的。

ex.en: Don't forget to turn off the gas.
ex.zh: 別忘了關瓦斯。

gas.en: a substance like air that is not solid or liquid, or one used for cooking

ex.en: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集起來看遊行。

ex.en: Everyone gathered together in the open space to meet.
ex.zh: 大家都在空地上集合開會。

gather.en: to come together in one place

ex.en: John kept gathering info.
ex.zh: 約翰持續收集資訊。

ex.en: We need to gather more data before we decide.
ex.zh: 做決定之前，我們需要收集更多資料。

gather.en: to bring things together from different places

ex.en: I gather that they'll agree with us.
ex.zh: 我猜他們會同意我們的看法。

ex.en: From what I gather, the meeting went well.
ex.zh: 據我所知，會議進行得很順利。

gather.en: to understand or believe something from what you have heard

ex.en: Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.
ex.zh: 請小心月台與車廂之間的空隙。

ex.en: There's a gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 圍籬上有個缺口。

gap.en: an empty space between two things

ex.en: The gap between them has narrowed.
ex.zh: 他們之間的差距已經縮小了。

ex.en: The gap between rich and poor is growing.
ex.zh: 貧富差距越來越大。

gap.en: a difference between two people, groups or things

ex.en: Can you explain the gap in your resume?
ex.zh: 你能解釋一下履歷上的空白期嗎？

ex.en: She took a gap year before college.
ex.zh: 她上大學前休了一年空檔年。

gap.en: a period of time when something stops or is missing

ex.en: Gay marriage is permitted in less than 20% of countries.
ex.zh: 全世界不到 20% 的國家允許同性婚姻。

ex.en: His mother doesn't know he's gay.
ex.zh: 他媽媽不知道他是同性戀。

gay.en: attracted to people of the same sex

ex.en: I gazed at the sea for hours.
ex.zh: 我凝望大海好幾個小時。

ex.en: We gazed at the beautiful scenery.
ex.zh: 我們凝望著美麗的風景。

gaze.en: to look at something for a long time

ex.en: I felt her gaze from behind.
ex.zh: 我感覺到她從背後投來的目光。

ex.en: She couldn't meet his gaze.
ex.zh: 她不敢直視他的目光。

ex.en: The streets were full of gaiety during the festival.
ex.zh: 節慶期間街上充滿歡樂的氣氛。

ex.en: Her gaiety lifted everyone's spirits.
ex.zh: 她的歡樂讓大家的精神都振奮起來。

gaiety.en: a feeling of being cheerful and full of fun

ex.en: Spring in the north sends gales to sweep the roads.
ex.zh: 北方的春天颳起狂風，橫掃街道。

ex.en: The ferry was cancelled because of the gale.
ex.zh: 渡輪因為強風而停駛。

ex.en: The audience gasped when the magician disappeared.
ex.zh: 魔術師消失時，觀眾都倒抽一口氣。

ex.en: He came out of the water gasping for air.
ex.zh: 他從水裡出來，大口喘著氣。

gasp.en: to breathe in quickly and loudly, for example from surprise

ex.en: She gave a gasp of surprise when she opened the gift.
ex.zh: 她打開禮物時驚訝地倒抽一口氣。

ex.en: There were gasps from the crowd as the plane landed safely.
ex.zh: 飛機安全降落時，人群中傳來陣陣驚呼。

gasp.en: a quick loud breath taken in because of surprise or pain

ex.en: This gadget tracks the temperature in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 這個小裝置會追蹤倉庫的溫度。

ex.en: He bought a useful gadget for his home office.
ex.zh: 他買了一個實用的小工具放在居家辦公室。

gadget.en: a small useful machine or tool

ex.en: The chef garnished the soup with fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 主廚在湯上撒了新鮮香草點綴。

ex.en: Garnish each plate with a slice of lemon.
ex.zh: 每個餐盤都放一片檸檬作為裝飾。

garnish.en: to add a small piece of food on top of a dish to make it look nice

ex.en: The charity gala raised funds for a new community clinic.
ex.zh: 這場慈善晚會為新建社區診所募得款項。

ex.en: Guests wore formal attire to the annual gala.
ex.zh: 賓客穿著正式服裝出席年度盛會。

gala.en: a special party or event, often to raise money

ex.en: The car is waiting at the gate.
ex.zh: 車在門口等著。

ex.en: It is time to shut the gate.
ex.zh: 該把大門關上了。

ex.en: Tom asked me to shut the gate.
ex.zh: 湯姆叫我把大門關上。

gate.en: a door in a fence or wall outside

ex.en: Our flight now departs from Gate 12.
ex.zh: 我們的航班現在改從 12 號登機門出發。

ex.en: Please go to the gate at least 30 minutes before departure.
ex.zh: 請在起飛前至少 30 分鐘到登機門。

gate.en: the place in an airport where you get on a plane

ex.en: They are often together, and go to the opera or visit art galleries.
ex.zh: 他們常常一起去聽歌劇或逛美術館。

ex.en: The gallery is showing works by local artists.
ex.zh: 這間美術館正在展出本地藝術家的作品。

gallery.en: a building or room where art is shown

garbled.zh: （聲音、訊息）斷斷續續、混亂不清的

ex.en: The connection was bad, and your message was garbled.
ex.zh: 訊號不好，你的訊息聽起來斷斷續續的。

ex.en: I received a garbled email full of strange symbols.
ex.zh: 我收到一封滿是奇怪符號的亂碼郵件。

garbled.en: unclear and mixed up so that it is hard to understand

ex.en: Add some garlic to the pan and stir for a minute.
ex.zh: 在鍋裡加一些大蒜，翻炒一分鐘。

ex.en: This soup has a strong smell of garlic.
ex.zh: 這道湯有濃濃的蒜味。

ex.en: I don't like garlic bread very much.
ex.zh: 我不太喜歡吃蒜香麵包。

ex.en: Our galaxy is called the Milky Way.
ex.zh: 我們所在的星系叫做銀河系。

ex.en: Astronomers have found a new galaxy far away.
ex.zh: 天文學家發現了一個遙遠的新星系。

ex.en: There are billions of stars in each galaxy.
ex.zh: 每個星系裡都有數十億顆恆星。

ex.en: He was taken to hospital with a gastric problem.
ex.zh: 他因胃部問題被送到醫院。

ex.en: Too much spicy food can cause gastric pain.
ex.zh: 吃太多辣的食物可能引起胃痛。

ex.en: We had a small family gathering on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我們星期天辦了一場小小的家庭聚會。

ex.en: A large gathering formed in the square.
ex.zh: 廣場上聚集了一大群人。

ex.en: The gathering of data took several months.
ex.zh: 資料的收集花了好幾個月。

ex.en: Berry gathering is popular in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天很流行採莓果。

ex.en: Gary repaired our fence over the weekend.
ex.zh: 蓋瑞週末修好了我們的籬笆。

ex.en: I'm going to the gym with Gary after work.
ex.zh: 我下班後要和蓋瑞去健身房。

gabriel.zh: 加百列（聖經中的天使長）

ex.en: In the Bible, the angel Gabriel brings important messages.
ex.zh: 在聖經中，天使加百列負責傳達重要的訊息。

ex.en: The painting shows Gabriel with large white wings.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪了長著白色大翅膀的加百列。

ex.en: Gabriel brought homemade bread to the picnic.
ex.zh: 加百列帶了自製的麵包來野餐。

ex.en: Our new classmate Gabriel moved here from Spain.
ex.zh: 我們的新同學加百列是從西班牙搬來的。

ex.en: Gambling can quickly become a serious problem.
ex.zh: 賭博很快就可能變成嚴重的問題。

ex.en: Gambling is not allowed in many countries.
ex.zh: 許多國家不允許賭博。

ex.en: He lost all his savings to gambling.
ex.zh: 他把所有積蓄都輸在賭博上了。

ex.en: My grandfather spends every morning gardening.
ex.zh: 我祖父每天早上都在整理花園。

ex.en: She bought gardening gloves and a small shovel.
ex.zh: 她買了園藝手套和一把小鏟子。

ex.en: Gardening is a relaxing hobby for many people.
ex.zh: 園藝對許多人來說是放鬆身心的嗜好。

ex.en: He had the gall to ask me for money again.
ex.zh: 他居然還有臉再向我要錢。

ex.en: I can't believe she had the gall to say that to my face.
ex.zh: 我不敢相信她竟然有膽當面對我說那種話。

ex.en: Gall is a bitter liquid made by the liver.
ex.zh: 膽汁是肝臟製造的一種苦味液體。

ex.en: The doctor removed his gall bladder, which stores gall.
ex.zh: 醫生切除了他儲存膽汁的膽囊。

ex.en: It galls me that he never says thank you.
ex.zh: 他從不說謝謝，真讓我惱火。

ex.en: Their rude answer galled her all day.
ex.zh: 他們無禮的回答讓她整天都很火大。

ex.en: A stone gateway marks the entrance to the old garden.
ex.zh: 一座石造的門樓標示出老花園的入口。

ex.en: The city is the gateway to the northern mountains.
ex.zh: 這座城市是通往北方山區的門戶。

ex.en: The gateway connects our home network to the internet.
ex.zh: 閘道器把我們家裡的網路連上網際網路。

ex.en: You need to restart the gateway if the connection drops.
ex.zh: 如果連線中斷，你得重新啟動閘道器。

gandhi.zh: 甘地（印度獨立運動領袖）

ex.en: Gandhi led India's non-violent movement for independence.
ex.zh: 甘地領導了印度的非暴力獨立運動。

ex.en: We read about Gandhi in our history class.
ex.zh: 我們在歷史課上讀到了甘地。

ex.en: A small garrison guarded the old fort.
ex.zh: 一小支守備部隊守衛著這座古堡。

ex.en: The garrison was supplied by boats every month.
ex.zh: 駐軍每個月靠船隻補給。

ex.en: The army garrisoned the border town.
ex.zh: 軍隊派兵駐守這個邊境小鎮。

ex.en: Troops were garrisoned in the castle for the winter.
ex.zh: 軍隊整個冬天駐紮在城堡裡。

ex.en: He spends his weekends gaming with his friends online.
ex.zh: 他週末都和朋友在線上打電玩。

ex.en: My brother bought a new computer for gaming.
ex.zh: 我哥哥買了一台新電腦來打電動。

ex.en: Gaming is only allowed in certain areas of the city.
ex.zh: 賭博只有在城裡某些區域才被允許。

ex.en: The government set strict rules on gaming.
ex.zh: 政府對賭博訂了嚴格的規定。

ex.en: The movie is about a gangster in the 1930s.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一九三〇年代的一名幫派分子。

ex.en: The police arrested a known gangster last night.
ex.zh: 警方昨晚逮捕了一名知名的幫派分子。

ex.en: The patient had a gastrointestinal infection after the trip.
ex.zh: 病人在旅行後得了腸胃道感染。

ex.en: Spicy food can irritate the gastrointestinal tract.
ex.zh: 辛辣食物可能刺激胃腸道。

ex.en: The horse began to gallop across the field.
ex.zh: 馬開始在田野上飛奔。

ex.en: The riders galloped along the beach at sunset.
ex.zh: 騎士們在日落時沿著海灘策馬奔馳。

ex.en: The horse broke into a gallop.
ex.zh: 馬突然開始飛奔起來。

ex.en: They crossed the valley at a gallop.
ex.zh: 他們策馬飛奔穿越山谷。

ex.en: The old man walked with a slow, careful gait.
ex.zh: 那位老先生以緩慢謹慎的步伐走著。

ex.en: The doctor watched her gait to check her injured knee.
ex.zh: 醫生觀察她走路的姿勢來檢查受傷的膝蓋。

ex.en: You can often recognize a friend by his gait from far away.
ex.zh: 你常常能從遠處憑走路的姿態認出朋友。

ex.en: The gambler lost all his savings in a single night.
ex.zh: 那個賭徒一夜之間輸光了所有積蓄。

ex.en: She is not a gambler, so she rarely buys lottery tickets.
ex.zh: 她不是賭徒，所以很少買彩券。

ex.en: The terrible smell made me gag.
ex.zh: 那股惡臭讓我想吐。

ex.en: He gagged when he tasted the bitter medicine.
ex.zh: 他一嚐到那苦藥就乾嘔起來。

ex.en: The running gag in the show is that he always loses his keys.
ex.zh: 這個節目一再出現的笑點就是他老是弄丟鑰匙。

ex.en: It was just a gag, so don't take it seriously.
ex.zh: 那只是個玩笑，別當真。

ex.en: The robbers gagged the guard with a scarf.
ex.zh: 搶匪用圍巾塞住警衛的嘴。

ex.en: The company tried to gag its employees from speaking to reporters.
ex.zh: 公司試圖封住員工的口，不讓他們對記者說話。

ex.en: She's a smart gal with a bright future.
ex.zh: 她是個聰明的姑娘，前途光明。

ex.en: My grandmother still calls her friends "the gals".
ex.zh: 我奶奶仍然稱她的朋友們為「姑娘們」。

gamma.zh: 希臘字母的第三個字母 γ

ex.en: Gamma is the third letter of the Greek alphabet.
ex.zh: Gamma 是希臘字母的第三個字母。

ex.en: The professor wrote a gamma on the board next to the formula.
ex.zh: 教授在黑板上的公式旁寫了一個 gamma。

galway.zh: 戈爾韋（愛爾蘭西部城市）

ex.en: Galway is a city on the west coast of Ireland.
ex.zh: 戈爾韋是愛爾蘭西海岸的一座城市。

ex.en: We took a bus from Dublin to Galway.
ex.zh: 我們從都柏林搭巴士去戈爾韋。

ex.en: The film garnered several awards at the festival.
ex.zh: 這部電影在影展上獲得了數個獎項。

ex.en: She garnered support from her classmates for the project.
ex.zh: 她為這個專案爭取到同學們的支持。

ex.en: There was a gaping hole in the wall after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後牆上出現一個大洞。

ex.en: He stared at the gaping mouth of the cave.
ex.zh: 他盯著洞穴張開的大口。

gaping.zh: 目瞪口呆地看（現在分詞）

ex.en: The tourists were gaping at the tall skyscrapers.
ex.zh: 遊客們目瞪口呆地望著高聳的摩天大樓。

ex.en: Stop gaping and help me carry these boxes.
ex.zh: 別傻傻地盯著看了，快來幫我搬這些箱子。

ex.en: The cook was busy in the ship's galley.
ex.zh: 廚師在船上的廚房裡忙得不可開交。

ex.en: Flight attendants prepared the meals in the galley.
ex.zh: 空服員在機上廚房準備餐點。

ex.en: The new law was published in the official gazette.
ex.zh: 新法律刊登在官方公報上。

ex.en: The local gazette reports news from nearby towns.
ex.zh: 地方報紙報導鄰近小鎮的新聞。

ex.en: Astronomers study the galactic center with large telescopes.
ex.zh: 天文學家用大型望遠鏡研究銀河中心。

ex.en: Our solar system sits in a spiral galactic arm.
ex.zh: 我們的太陽系位於銀河系的一條螺旋臂上。

ex.en: The company faces a problem of galactic proportions.
ex.zh: 這家公司面臨規模龐大的問題。

ex.en: His ego is of galactic size.
ex.zh: 他的自尊心大得驚人。

ex.en: The gallant firefighter went back into the building to save the dog.
ex.zh: 那位英勇的消防員衝回大樓去救那隻狗。

ex.en: The team made a gallant effort but lost the match.
ex.zh: 球隊奮勇拚搏，但仍輸掉了比賽。

ex.en: He was gallant enough to open the door for every woman.
ex.zh: 他殷勤有禮，為每位女士開門。

ex.en: It was a gallant gesture to offer her his coat in the rain.
ex.zh: 在雨中把外套借給她，是個很紳士的舉動。

ex.en: The old house has a tall gable facing the street.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子有一面朝向街道的高山牆。

ex.en: A small window sits high in the gable.
ex.zh: 山牆高處有一扇小窗戶。

ex.en: The thief was sent to gaol for two years.
ex.zh: 那名小偷被關進監獄兩年。

ex.en: The old gaol in the town is now a museum.
ex.zh: 鎮上的舊監獄現在是一間博物館。

ex.en: The judge gaoled him for stealing from the shop.
ex.zh: 法官因為他在店裡行竊而將他監禁。

ex.en: In the past, people were gaoled for not paying their debts.
ex.zh: 過去的人會因為還不出債而被關進牢裡。

ex.en: Gatwick is one of the airports that serve London.
ex.zh: 蓋特威克是服務倫敦的機場之一。

ex.en: Our flight to Gatwick landed early this morning.
ex.zh: 我們飛往蓋特威克的班機今早提早降落。

ex.en: She is learning Gaelic so she can talk with her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她正在學蓋爾語，好跟祖父母交談。

ex.en: Signs in some parts of Scotland are written in English and Gaelic.
ex.zh: 蘇格蘭部分地區的路標同時用英語和蓋爾語書寫。

ex.en: We listened to a Gaelic song at the festival.
ex.zh: 我們在慶典上聽了一首蓋爾語歌曲。

ex.en: The village keeps many old Gaelic traditions alive.
ex.zh: 這個村莊保留了許多古老的蓋爾傳統。

ex.en: The children wore garlands of flowers on their heads.
ex.zh: 孩子們頭上戴著花環。

ex.en: A garland of leaves hung above the door.
ex.zh: 門上掛著一圈樹葉編成的花環。

ex.en: They garlanded the stage with fresh flowers for the festival.
ex.zh: 他們為慶典用鮮花花環裝飾了舞台。

ex.en: The winner was garlanded and carried through the town.
ex.zh: 優勝者被戴上花環，在鎮上被抬著遊行。

ex.en: Galileo used a telescope to observe the moons of Jupiter.
ex.zh: 伽利略用望遠鏡觀察木星的衛星。

ex.en: Galileo was an Italian scientist who lived in the 1500s and 1600s.
ex.zh: 伽利略是生活在十六至十七世紀的義大利科學家。

gathered.zh: 聚集；收集（gather 的過去式）

ex.en: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the parade.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集在廣場上看遊行。

ex.en: She gathered her books and hurried out of the classroom.
ex.zh: 她收拾好書本，匆忙離開教室。

ex.en: I gathered from his smile that the news was good.
ex.zh: 我從他的笑容推斷這是個好消息。

ex.en: From what I gathered, the meeting has been moved to Friday.
ex.zh: 就我所了解，會議已經改到星期五了。

ex.en: The children sang gaily as they walked to school.
ex.zh: 孩子們一路快樂地唱著歌走去學校。

ex.en: The streets were gaily decorated for the festival.
ex.zh: 街道為了慶典佈置得色彩繽紛。

ex.en: The gates of the park close at six o'clock.
ex.zh: 公園的大門在六點關閉。

ex.en: Passengers must be at the gates thirty minutes before boarding.
ex.zh: 乘客必須在登機前三十分鐘到達登機門。

ex.en: The actors appeared in medieval garb.
ex.zh: 演員們穿著中世紀的服裝登場。

ex.en: He arrived at the party in his usual casual garb.
ex.zh: 他穿著平常的休閒裝扮來到派對。

ex.en: The children were garbed as pirates for the parade.
ex.zh: 孩子們為了遊行打扮成海盜。

ex.en: She garbed herself in a long black coat.
ex.zh: 她穿上一件黑色長大衣。

ex.en: Drinking too much coffee can make gastritis worse.
ex.zh: 咖啡喝太多會讓胃炎惡化。

ex.en: The doctor said my stomach pain was caused by gastritis.
ex.zh: 醫師說我的胃痛是胃炎造成的。

ex.en: The speech galvanized the crowd into action.
ex.zh: 這場演講激勵群眾採取行動。

ex.en: The disaster galvanized people to donate money.
ex.zh: 這場災難促使人們捐款。

ex.en: Workers galvanize the steel to stop it from rusting.
ex.zh: 工人為鋼材鍍鋅以防生鏽。

ex.en: The fence is made of galvanized metal.
ex.zh: 這道圍欄是鍍鋅金屬做的。

ex.en: The movie made us feel the whole gamut of emotions.
ex.zh: 這部電影讓我們體驗了各種情緒。

ex.en: The store sells a wide gamut of products, from toys to tools.
ex.zh: 這家店賣的商品範圍很廣，從玩具到工具都有。

ex.en: The children gaped at the giant dinosaur skeleton.
ex.zh: 孩子們張大嘴巴看著巨大的恐龍骨架。

ex.en: Don't gape at people; it is rude.
ex.zh: 不要盯著別人發呆，這樣很沒禮貌。

ex.en: There was a wide gape in the old fence.
ex.zh: 舊籬笆上有一道很寬的裂口。

ex.en: He stared with a gape of surprise.
ex.zh: 他驚訝得張大了嘴看著。

ex.en: We saw a gator resting by the river.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻短吻鱷在河邊休息。

ex.en: The old gator slid quietly into the water.
ex.zh: 那隻老鱷魚悄悄滑入水中。

ex.en: The nurse covered the cut with clean gauze.
ex.zh: 護理師用乾淨的紗布蓋住傷口。

ex.en: The curtains were made of thin white gauze.
ex.zh: 那些窗簾是用薄薄的白紗做的。

ex.en: She wore a gaudy dress covered in bright sequins.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件綴滿亮片、俗豔花俏的洋裝。

ex.en: The shop window was full of gaudy souvenirs.
ex.zh: 店家櫥窗裡擺滿了花俏的紀念品。

ex.en: The knight pulled on his iron gauntlet before the fight.
ex.zh: 騎士在戰鬥前戴上鐵製護手手套。

ex.en: The museum displays a gauntlet from the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 博物館展示了一隻中世紀的護手手套。

ex.en: The new student had to run the gauntlet of curious questions on his first day.
ex.zh: 新同學第一天就得面對一連串好奇的盤問。

ex.en: Reporters made them run the gauntlet to reach the car.
ex.zh: 記者們讓他們穿過重重包圍才走到車旁。

ex.en: The gatekeeper checked our tickets at the entrance.
ex.zh: 看門人在入口檢查我們的票。

ex.en: Editors act as gatekeepers who decide what gets published.
ex.zh: 編輯扮演把關者，決定哪些內容能出版。

ex.en: After weeks of illness, his face looked gaunt.
ex.zh: 病了好幾週之後，他的臉顯得憔悴消瘦。

ex.en: A gaunt old man stood at the doorway.
ex.zh: 一位消瘦的老人站在門口。

ex.en: He had a deep gash on his knee after falling off the bike.
ex.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來後，膝蓋上有一道很深的傷口。

ex.en: A long gash ran across the side of the old boat.
ex.zh: 一道長長的裂縫橫過那艘舊船的側面。

ex.en: She gashed her hand on a piece of broken glass.
ex.zh: 她的手被一塊碎玻璃劃出一道深傷口。

ex.en: The sharp rock gashed the tire and the car stopped.
ex.zh: 尖銳的石頭劃破了輪胎，車子就停了下來。

galvanized.zh: 鍍鋅；激勵（galvanize 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: The workers galvanized the steel pipes to keep them from rusting.
ex.zh: 工人替鋼管鍍鋅，避免生鏽。

ex.en: The speech galvanized the crowd into action.
ex.zh: 那場演說激勵群眾採取行動。

ex.en: She wore a blue garter at her wedding.
ex.zh: 她在婚禮上戴了一條藍色的襪帶。

ex.en: The old man fastened a garter below each knee.
ex.zh: 老先生在每個膝蓋下方都繫了一條襪帶。

ex.en: The room was painted in garish pink and orange.
ex.zh: 這個房間漆成了俗豔的粉紅和橘色。

ex.en: He wore a garish shirt covered in big flowers.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件印滿大花、花哨刺眼的襯衫。

ex.en: Don't gawk at people on the street; it's rude.
ex.zh: 不要在街上盯著別人看，這很不禮貌。

ex.en: Drivers slowed down to gawk at the accident.
ex.zh: 駕駛人放慢車速，目不轉睛地看著那起事故。

ex.en: They faced the gargantuan task of cleaning the whole beach.
ex.zh: 他們面臨清理整片海灘這項龐大的任務。

ex.en: A gargantuan wave rose over the small boat.
ex.zh: 一道巨浪在小船上方高高湧起。

ex.en: A ganglion is a group of nerve cells outside the brain.
ex.zh: 神經節是腦以外的一群神經細胞。

ex.en: The biology book has a picture of a ganglion in an insect.
ex.zh: 生物課本裡有一張昆蟲神經節的圖。

ex.en: The doctor said the lump on my wrist was a ganglion.
ex.zh: 醫生說我手腕上的腫塊是腱鞘囊腫。

ex.en: A ganglion often goes away without treatment.
ex.zh: 腱鞘囊腫常常不用治療就會消失。

ex.en: Water becomes gaseous when it boils and turns into steam.
ex.zh: 水沸騰變成水蒸氣時就成了氣態。

ex.en: Oxygen is a gaseous element at room temperature.
ex.zh: 氧在室溫下是氣態元素。

ex.en: We had a picnic under the gazebo in the park.
ex.zh: 我們在公園的涼亭下野餐。

ex.en: They built a wooden gazebo in the garden.
ex.zh: 他們在花園裡蓋了一座木造涼亭。

gambit.zh: 開局策略；先發制人的手段

ex.en: Moving his queen early was a risky gambit.
ex.zh: 他早早把皇后移出去是個冒險的開局手法。

ex.en: Offering a lower price was a clever gambit to win the deal.
ex.zh: 提出較低的價格是為了談成這筆生意的聰明策略。

ex.en: He opened the talk with a joke as a gambit.
ex.zh: 他以一則笑話作為談話的開場。

ex.en: Her usual gambit at parties is to ask about your travels.
ex.zh: 她在派對上慣用的開場話題是問你去哪裡旅行。

ex.en: They live in a gated community with a security guard.
ex.zh: 他們住在有警衛的門禁社區。

ex.en: The gated entrance keeps strangers out of the park.
ex.zh: 有柵門的入口讓陌生人進不了公園。

ex.en: The shop has bargains galore this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末店裡有大量的特價商品。

ex.en: At the festival there were games and food galore.
ex.zh: 園遊會上有許多遊戲和美食。

ex.en: The judge struck the gavel and called for silence.
ex.zh: 法官敲了法槌，要求大家安靜。

ex.en: She banged the gavel to start the meeting.
ex.zh: 她敲下議事槌宣布會議開始。

ex.en: A gaggle of geese crossed the road in front of our car.
ex.zh: 一群鵝在我們車前過馬路。

ex.en: A gaggle of tourists gathered around the guide.
ex.zh: 一群吵吵鬧鬧的遊客圍在導遊身邊。

ex.en: The politician made an embarrassing gaffe during the interview.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物在訪談中出了個令人尷尬的失言。

ex.en: Calling her by the wrong name was a real gaffe.
ex.zh: 把她的名字叫錯真是個大糗事。

ex.en: A stone gargoyle looked down from the cathedral roof.
ex.zh: 一隻石頭滴水獸從大教堂屋頂往下看。

ex.en: Rainwater poured from the mouth of the gargoyle.
ex.zh: 雨水從滴水獸的嘴裡流出來。

ex.en: The gamekeeper walked the estate every morning.
ex.zh: 獵場看守人每天早上巡視莊園。

ex.en: A gamekeeper protects the birds and animals on the land.
ex.zh: 獵場看守人負責保護土地上的鳥類與動物。
